text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for Oguri Cap to start
her senior year. We pay a visit to a
shrine to ring in the New
Year and pray
for her success on the track.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just thinking about the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know it was some time ago now, but... I
just can't
forget it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The cheers from the crowd, the energy
all
around... That day is on my mind
twenty-four
seven.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I definitely understand where she's
coming from.
No other race gets the fans
as hyped up as the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's thanks to my fans that I can keep
running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'd love for them to pick me for the Arima Kinen. I want to win—and to keep winning.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. I've gotta get stronger.
choice_data_list: Super Creek is waiting for us, too.
Super Creek is waiting for us, too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Hopefully our prayers are
answered...
choice_data_list: Shall we wish for that at the shri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What else should I wish for on my prayer
tablet?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course. There are still plenty of
tough
races ahead, after all.
choice_data_list: Pray for good health: "A healthy U...
Aim to be the strongest: 'Become a...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So essentially, I have to look after my
health. In
that case...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should make eating lots of food
my wish
instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her there's no point in praying for
that since
she already eats plenty.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a beast, huh? You're funny. That
isn't a bad
wish though.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I have unparalleled strength, maybe I
won't get
lost so often...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While not completely out of the
question, I still advise her to rely on
somebody else's guidance
for the time
being.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Skills? Like cooking skills?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh... I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But if I were able to cook...
I could enjoy
food
even more than I do now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Expanding on her abilities is great and
all, but I
wish she'd learn the secret of
not overeating too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, I'm finished writing. Why don't
we start
heading home?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here for your New Year's shrine visit?
Guess ya
got a lot to pray for, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Not me, though. I got a declaration to
make—I'm
gonna be the best!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's with the long face? C'mon,
Oguri, put a li'l
more fire in your belly!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I can't. I...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can seriously compete
against you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...I'm such a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here I was thinkin' ya saw me as a
rival...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't've been further from the truth,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No! Tama, I...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, you also just
see me as
an annoyin' li'l squirt.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No. There's nothing I can really say...
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure you don't need to ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the year-end Arima Kinen, Tamamo
Cross declared war against
Oguri Cap, and Oguri
Cap hasn't been
quite herself ever since...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I underestimate her. I've
always
known I'd compete against her
one day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But... Tama always treats me like a
friend. And
that makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've never had a friend like her
before—someone I could compete with,
run side by side with, and
who also
understood what I was going through.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why I ended up taking her
for
granted.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All Tama wanted was to compete with
me in
earnest, but I reacted in the worst
possible way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap was miles ahead of her
competitors back in her hometown,
which makes it very confusing for her to
have someone be both a friend and rival
at once.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I will.
choice_data_list: We need to clear up this misunders...
We've got to clear up this misunde...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how close the two of them are,
there's no doubt in my mind that their
relationship will eventually get back on
track. Holding on to that belief, I wrap
up our shrine visit.
